files.name: motion-prompt-112.txt
PROMPT.md
files.content:
Please use "Vignette" (周辺減光（ビネット）), one of the names in "Photo looks, lighting & styles".
Motion Prompt #112

What it is: The corners darken and draw the eye to the centre
What the sample shows: The frame darkens smoothly from the corners while the person and the road in the middle stay bright.
Spec:
- Scene 2: a street corner; buildings, trees and street lamps (x 114, 292, 494) behind a road at y 132–162; the person stands front left (feet at x 176, y 200, 124 px tall). 
- Shape: an ellipse centred on the frame (vertical radius = horizontal × 208/539 × 1.35)
- Clear out to 45% of the 334 px horizontal radius, then rgb(32,35,43) rising from 0% to 70% towards the edge
- Timing: the effect comes in from 0.4 s to 1.4 s, holds until 4.0 s and is gone again by 4.8 s (one pass = 5 s, cubic ease-in-out (about cubic-bezier(0.65,0,0.35,1)))
When to use it: To focus attention on the subject, or to suggest an old lens.

Reference implementation (Canvas 2D, a function whose picture depends only on the time): https://showheyohtaki.github.io/motion-prompt/api/v1/en/e/112.txt
Shared helper code: https://showheyohtaki.github.io/motion-prompt/api/v1/kit/photo.js
Keep the shapes, timing and easing values of the reference implementation as they are, and change only the text, colours and assets to fit what I am making.
